svg.title: Light paths around a black hole
svg.desc: Light rays passing a non-rotating black hole, computed from d2u/dphi2 = 3u^2 - u. Rays closer than 5.2 M fall in, rays near 5.2 M circle the photon sphere at 3 M, and the rest are bent and escape.
